items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I played with Farzola... We played some jobs together.

ctx.x: What were some of your other favorite bands during the early days that you heard in person? Do you remember any of them?

Well, I remember going to some of these dance halls around here, like the Fuen. And I can remember fellas like Buzzy Willows, he's dead. Farzola. I played with Farzola, he was a little boy too. He was in Short Pass too. We played some jobs together. And I had to Woodman Hall. And I played one job with Sidney Aridon. The fella that was co-composer with Hoagie Carmichael, I think, on Lazy River. One time, that's all I remember was Sidney Aridon. After he came back from wherever he went away from me, I guess up…
What style would he play? Would he play just a straight four?
